test_matrix.evidence: MCP sync result is parsed into a succeeded observation, JSON result map, and running loop metadata.
Allowed async tool invokes once, persists waiting_async receipt metadata, then resumes through the live downstream observer.
A stored result emitted by SubscribeAllWithEOSE is accepted during resume before any live event is needed.
Terminal failed downstream status becomes a failed tool observation while clearing waiting_async.
Observer/relay closure returns a blocked failed observation and sets AssistantSession.State plus agent_loop state to blocked.
Review-mode mutation stores an AssistantDeferredAction and never calls the MCP server.
Explicit deny rule returns denied observation and does not call sync or async MCP execution.
Recovery fails closed and publishes blocked session/status when waiting_async metadata exists but no agent runtime is configured.
AssistantSessionRecoveryRunner detects agent_loop waiting_async and calls Runtime.ResumeAsync.
Repeated execution of the same waiting tool call returns the stored receipt without invoking the async MCP publisher again.
